title: `Node.get_window()` doesn't work when called from a thread. `Node.get_tree().root` does.
body: ### Tested versions Reproducible in: 4.5.1.rc1, 4.4.1.stable ### System information Linux ### Issue description This might just be a documentation issue but it doesn't seem like it should work like this: `Node.get_window()` fails with: > [!CAUTION] > E 0:00:00:313 node.gd:13 @ get_root(): Caller thread can't call this function in this node (/root/Node). Use call_deferred() or call_thread_group() instead. Condition "!is_accessible_from_caller_thread()" is true. Returning: (nullptr) scene/main/node.cpp:2050 @ get_window() node.gd:13 @ get_root() Whereas `Node.get_tree().root` works fine. Now since the [Thread-safe APIs](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/tutorials/performance/thread_safe_apis.html) section of the docs mentions that _"Interacting with the active scene tree is NOT thread-safe."_, I'd imagine that `Node.get_tree()` would also require `call_deferred()` in order to work. Either that or `get_window()` should work just fine, since _"If the node is in the main window, this is equivalent to getting the root node (`get_tree().get_root()`)."_ ### Steps to reproduce Run the code below or the MRP. ```GDScript func _ready() -> void: print_rich("[color=orange]Main Thread:") get_root() print_rich("\n[color=orange]WorkerThreadPool:") var id := WorkerThreadPool.add_task(get_root) WorkerThreadPool.wait_for_task_completion(id) func get_root() -> void: var window: bool = false if get_window() == null else true print_rich("get_window(): [color=%s]%s" % ["green" if window else "red", window]) var tree: bool = false if get_tree().root == null else true print_rich("get_tree().root: [color=%s]%s" % ["green" if tree else "red", tree]) ``` ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [threaded-root-window.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/22679530/threaded-root-window.zip)
